bio: In an elegant, pared-back setting, you can enjoy cuisine made with top-notch produce by chef Jean-Claude Cahagnet, whose experience can't be argued with and who leaves us in no doubt about his penchant for herbs and spices. Regular diners keep coming back for the high-quality matured purebred meats, presented in a tempting window display. The hostess provides a warm welcome and impeccable service....
